# Expertise.com

> A local professional directory connecting consumers with top-rated service providers through data-driven selection methodology and expert marketplace services.

Expertise.com evaluates over 60,000 businesses monthly using a rigorous five-variable scoring system to help consumers find the best local professionals across U.S. cities. The platform offers business listings, lead generation services, and a concierge matching service for vetted service providers.

## Key Topics

- Selection process and methodology
- Business listing and reviews
- Lead generation services
- Expert marketplace
- Service provider vetting
- Concierge matching service
- Local professionals directory
- Provider Portal
- Award badges and recognition
- Five-variable scoring system
- Data-driven evaluation
- Business profile management
- Marketing agreements
- Consumer-provider connections

## About Expertise.com

- [Hire the Best Local Professionals](https://www.expertise.com): Homepage for finding top-rated local service providers across US cities
- [About Us](https://www.expertise.com/about): Company overview of local professional directory and selection process
- [Our Selection Process](https://www.expertise.com/about/our-selection-process): Methodology scoring 60,000+ businesses monthly across five key variables

## For Service Providers

- [Get Reviewed by Expertise.com](https://www.expertise.com/review-me): Business review application for service providers seeking listing
- [Listing Updates](https://www.expertise.com/update): Provider portal for managing business profiles and award badges
- [Expertise Marketing Agreement](https://www.expertise.com/about/expertise-marketing-agreement): Marketing service terms for lead generation and sponsorship payments

## Legal & Privacy

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.expertise.com/about/privacy): Privacy policy detailing data collection practices by Forbes Digital
